goal: PG-408: models for maintenance, example_tools and modules

components.summary: Skill installation, test-file manifest extraction and portable example headers
responsibilities: Install the physicsguard skill by replacing its copy in --target and removing retired skill directories; --check and --dry-run change nothing
Publish the exact final version commit through the repository release workflow
Keep portable example headers on the canonical hierarchy commands for both tree and single-system audits
side_effects: Write staged consumer files and replace installed members transactionally
Create the final version tag and stable GitHub Release via .github/workflows/publish-release.yml

components.summary: Synthetic heated-tank external simulator with an explicit import-safe entrypoint
responsibilities: Keep optional example tooling outside the native simulation runtime
Generate the finite heated-tank CSV and map only measured signals with explicit unit conversions
side_effects: Write the requested finite heated-tank CSV only when main is called

components.summary: Physical residual modules and registry declarations
responsibilities: Define documented low-fidelity equations, SI units, assumptions and finite validity ranges
Describe registered native variables, parameter reads, residual text and applicability using explicitly marked synthetic examples without solving
Keep the equation library under concrete per-relation unit tests; these relations have no separate lifecycle workflow model
side_effects: Temporarily chain and restore the current-thread Python profiler only during description construction to record copied parameter reads
